regions.region: page 2 title, abstract, author block, and ESI placeholder
regions.finding: The source-derived title is Copper-Catalyzed Radical Approach to Allenyl Iodides. The ESI sentence is an accepted-manuscript placeholder and workspace SI association remains unestablished; no SI fact was imported.

Two cited prior-work approaches were classified separately: propargyl-alcohol/mesylate halide substitution and electrophilic cyclization of nucleophile-bearing enynes. They are literature examples, not current experiments.
The generic current CuI/1,10-phen radical-addition class is a general scheme; the page-6 graphical abstract is the same summary transformation.
Four independent TsBr optimization experiments were retained: 1a at 25/50 °C for 8 h and 1b at 25/50 °C for 4 h, with distinct product yields and recovered-starting-material yields.
Two TsI experiments were retained: 1a gives 5aa/6aa at 57%/14%, while 1b gives 6ba at 94% and 5ba is not formed. Product-specific outcomes remain in one record per reaction.

unresolved: Scheme 1 structures are generic or prior-work summaries.
Scheme 2 omits absolute scale/solvent volume and all operational workups and yield/recovery bases.
No SI association was inferred from the placeholder sentence.

regions.region: page 3 left Table 1 header, 19 product drawings, superscripts, and footnotes
regions.finding: Nineteen distinct 2-alkyl-substituted-enyne scope experiments were retained. The first seven superscript-a rows use 1.0 equiv TsI; the remaining twelve superscript-b rows use 1.3 equiv. All use 1 mmol enyne, CuI 10 mol%, 1,10-phen 20 mol%, CHCl3 10 mL, 25 °C, and the header's 15 min. The 1.2381 g annotation belongs to 6pa only.
ORTEP of 6na is characterization of its Table 1 experiment, not a second synthesis and not machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 3 right-center Table 2 header, seven product drawings, row times, and footnote
regions.finding: Seven distinct 2-aryl-substituted-enyne experiments were retained with row-specific 40–120 min times and 64–86% reported yields under the shared 1 mmol/1 equiv TsI/CuI/phen/CHCl3/25 °C conditions.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 3 and preceding prose
regions.finding: Five distinct arylsulfonyl-iodide scope experiments were retained with 87–94% reported yields. The separate TsCl/1b standard-condition trial is an explicit no-reaction experiment with 63% 1b recovery and 79% TsCl recovery.

unresolved: Table yields are reported without an explicit measurement/isolated basis in the inspected main text.
Most product structures are compact drawings and remain label/description candidates with null SMILES.
Atmosphere, workup, purification, and most product masses are not reported.

regions.finding: Confirms Table 3 shared 1 mmol enyne/1 equiv arylsulfonyl iodide/CuI 10 mol%/1,10-phen 20 mol%/CHCl3 10 mL/25 °C conditions; it enriches the five rows and TsCl control rather than creating a generic experiment.
TEMPO (2 equiv) under the standard 1b/TsI conditions for 70 min gives no observed 6ba and 96% recovered 1b; this is a distinct failed/control experiment.
Cyclopropyl enyne 7 gives ring-opened (E)-8 in 62% after 15 min. The E assignment and nOe basis are product-specific outcomes.
LCuI/LCuI2, Ts radical, IN-1–IN-4, copper coupling/reductive elimination, and iodine-abstraction branches are a proposed mechanism; intermediates are not isolated preparations.

Three distinct synthetic applications were retained: Et3N conversion of 6xa to (Z)-9 (100%), phenylboronic-acid coupling of 6pa to 10 (60%), and cyclopentenylboronic-acid coupling of 6pa to 11 (70%), with separate reagent loadings/times.

unresolved: Control/application experiments omit absolute scale, workup, purification, product masses, and most outcome bases.
Scheme 5 is proposed and its intermediates are not independently observed.
Detection limit for the TEMPO non-observation is not reported.
